lines.en: Where was the Statue of Liberty made?
lines.cn: 自由女神像是在哪里制造的？

lines.en: One of the most famous monuments in the world, the Statue of Liberty,
lines.cn: 自由女神像是世界最著名的纪念碑之一。

lines.en: was presented to the USA in the nineteenth century by the people of France.
lines.cn: 这一事物是在十九世纪由法国人介绍给美国的。

lines.en: The great statue, which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.
lines.cn: 这座宏伟的雕像由雕塑家奥古斯特·巴托尔迪设计，耗时十年才完成。

lines.en: The actual figure was made of copper supported by a metal framework which had been especially constructed by Eiffel.
lines.cn: 这个实物是由铜制成的，其结构由一个金属框架支撑；这个金属框架是埃菲尔专门为这个作品设计的。

lines.en: Before it could be transported to the United States,
a site had to be found for it and a pedestal had to be built.
lines.cn: 必须为它找一个合适的地点，并且还要为其搭建一个基座（或支撑结构）。

lines.en: The site chosen was an island at the entrance of New York Harbour.
lines.cn: 所选的位置是一座位于纽约港入口处的岛屿。

lines.en: By 1884, a statue which was 151 feet tall had been erected in Paris.
lines.cn: 到1884年，一座高151英尺的雕像已经在巴黎竖立起来了。

lines.en: The following year, it was taken to pieces and sent to America.
lines.cn: 第二年，它被拆解成零件，然后被运往了美国。

lines.en: the statue had been put together again and it was officially presented to the American people by Bartholdi.
lines.cn: 这座雕像已经被重新组装完成，并由巴托尔迪正式献给了美国人民。

lines.en: Ever since then, the great monument has been a symbol of liberty
lines.cn: 从那时起，这座宏伟的纪念碑就成为了自由的象征。

lines.en: for the millions of people who have passed through New York Harbour to make their homes in America.
lines.cn: 对于那些曾经穿越纽约港、最终在美国安家落户的数百万人来说……
